items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you ever run into Lazy Daddy... Did you ever play with him? INTERVIEWEE: No, I never played with him.

ctx.x: No, you couldn't be. You never make it. You make it for nothing much as good as that. And he said, you want a drink? You have to take a bottle. I said, uh huh. He said, take a little. I said, I'll take a little. I used to drink but I didn't drink like they drink, you know? I took a drink. I took a drink. I took a drink. I said, whiskey. I said, you're going to play tonight? He said, we didn't even think so. We used to play, everybody else was going to play. I said, we didn't know that. People didn't tell us. They…

Did you ever run into Lazy Daddy, a piano player over there? Lazy Daddy Fillmore, they called him. The Bunkers used to talk about him. Other people say he's dead now. Yeah. Did you hear him? Did you ever play with him?
No, I never played with him. I wasn't.
